messages:
acme_integration: Hey team — noticed trial credits didn't decrement after a bulk upload yesterday. Uploaded 10 files via our chunked uploader, got 200s back but dashboard still shows full trial balance. request_ids: req_20260315_01, req_20260315_02

acme_integration: We used the Python SDK -> client.upload_chunk(...); client.finalize_upload(...) pattern. Finalize returned 202 for a few, and then client retried and got 502 for one chunk. After retries everything succeeded but credits still at starting amount.

sarah_support: Sorry about the trouble — can you paste one full request/response pair headers (no secrets) and the customer account id so we can trace? Also which org/org_id? :straight_ruler:

acme_integration: org_id: acme-inc-42. Here's a redacted response header for req_20260315_01:
```
HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
x-request-id: req_20260315_01
x-internal-finalize-status: pending
Content-Type: application/json
```
And for the final finalize call for the same upload:
```
HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
x-request-id: req_20260315_01-finalize
x-internal-finalize-status: accepted
```
We also saw intermittent 502s on chunk POSTs around 15:24:03 UTC.

sarah_support: Thanks — I'm looking at logs now. Quick Q: were you using the streaming/chunked endpoint or batching multiple independent upload calls? The billing path differs.

acme_integration: streaming chunked upload to /v1/uploads/chunk with an explicit finalize call to /v1/uploads/finalize. Not the embeddings batch endpoint.

sarah_support: Filing to billing & eng — pinging them. @mike_billing @elliot_eng can you take a look?

mike_billing: pulling ledger entries for acme-inc-42 around 2026-03-15T15:23-15:30Z. I see API logs with token counts but no corresponding debit transaction for several of those request_ids. Looks like finalization trigger that creates the debit didn't fire for req_20260315_01 and req_20260315_02. Will need engineering confirmation whether finalize webhook failed or if payment flow skipped.

elliot_eng: Investigating. From the runtime trace it looks like for chunked uploads when the finalize handler returns 202 -> accepted we should emit a finalize_event to the billing pipeline. I see a code path where if the finalize response is 202 and we treat it as async, but an upstream retry (502) can cause the re-entrant flow to mark the session closed without emitting the billing event.

elliot_eng: Repro steps so far: 1) POST chunk (ok) 2) POST last chunk -> handler returns 202 (processing) 3) client calls finalize -> service returns 202, but a transient 502 on a chunk retry causes the finalize_event to be dropped in the worker queue. Result: user-visible success, but billing never sees finalize event -> no debit.

sarah_support: Can we confirm whether this affects all chunked uploads or only ones that saw retries? And is this limited to trial credits or all accounts?

elliot_eng: So far repro only on uploads that had a 5xx retry during the finalization sequence. It affects both trial and paid accounts because the billing debit is tied to finalize_event emission. Trial accounts just notice it quickly because balances are small.

mike_billing: For acme-inc-42 I can apply a manual debit to reconcile now if customer approves. Otherwise we'll wait for the fix then retroactively reconcile. Manual adjustment will show as invoice adjustment and email to billing contact.

acme_integration: We'd appreciate immediate adjustment — could you apply the debit and confirm? We need accurate usage for our internal reporting.

mike_billing: Confirmed — applying manual debit for the missing tokens from 2026-03-15 window. I need an opt-in confirmation: "ACME consents to manual ledger adjustment" in this thread to proceed.

acme_integration: ACME consents to manual ledger adjustment. Thanks.

elliot_eng: I'll open a patch. Short-term mitigation: add stronger idempotency for finalize_event emission and make the worker ack retry-resilient. We'll roll a hotfix to production in the next deploy window (within 2 hours).

sarah_support: I'll mark this as escalated and update the ticket. Please include the QA steps once hotfix is deployed.

elliot_eng: Hotfix plan: 1) change finalize_event emission to single-writer with durable enqueue 2) add retry until ACK for 5xx during finalize flow 3) add smoke test simulating chunk retry during finalize. Deploying to canary now.

runtime_bot: deploy 1795016 by elliot_eng -> canary started (services: uploads, billing-worker). :rocket:

elliot_eng: Canary looks good — finalize_event now persists even when a chunk POST returns 502 during the window. Billing worker consumed and emitted debit. Rolling to prod in 20m.

mike_billing: Manual debit applied and visible in ledger for acme-inc-42. Please confirm ACME sees updated balance in dashboard (may require refresh or logout/login).

acme_integration: Confirmed — dashboard shows the adjusted usage and trial balance decreased accordingly. Thanks everyone.

sarah_support: Closing loop: manual reconciliation done, hotfix deployed to prod, and engineering will follow up with a postmortem entry. If anything else crops up please re-open. :white_check_mark:
